description:
Non-required nits and improvements surfaced by the code review of
explorer-surface-trust-tiers-as-badges.  The Required issue (ListTable
missing trustFilter propagation) was fixed immediately post-review.
This item tracks the three remaining nit/consider findings.

preserves.behavior: Trust chip behavior for all current labels - maintainer, community, ci-verified, local
TrustBadge rendering for all labels in TrustBadge.test.tsx - all 13 tests must pass

verifications.command: cd results-explorer && npm test -- TrustBadge BenchmarkIndex
cd results-explorer && npm run typecheck && npm test

work_units.notes:
BenchmarkIndex.tsx:270 - chip label uses `.split("-")[0]` which extracts
only the first hyphen-delimited word.  Works for current labels
("maintainer-run" → "maintainer", "community-submission" → "community")
but would silently misbehave for a multi-word label like
"internal-team-verified" → "internal" instead of a meaningful abbreviation.

Fix: create an explicit TRUST_LABEL_ABBREV map:
  const TRUST_LABEL_ABBREV: Record<string, string> = {
    "maintainer-run": "Maintainer",
    "community-submission": "Community",
    "ci-verified": "CI",
    "local": "Local",
  };
Fall back to the full label or first word for unknown tiers.
work_units.summary: Make trust chip label abbreviation explicit rather than split('-')[0]

work_units.notes:
TrustBadge.tsx:57 - unknown labels fall back to DEFAULT_CONFIG whose title
is "Trust level not recorded".  But unknown labels ARE recorded - the issue
is they aren't in the registry yet.  The tooltip is misleading.

Fix: generate a dynamic tooltip for the fallback path:
  title: `Trust tier: ${trustLabel} (unrecognised - contact maintainers)`
This tells users the value was present, just unrecognised by the frontend.
work_units.summary: Improve tooltip text for unrecognised trust labels in TrustBadge

work_units.notes:
TrustBadge.tsx:51 - no input guard; arbitrary strings render as-is.
If manifest.json is malformed or a future field is null, the component
would either crash (null/undefined) or render garbage.

Fix: add a short-circuit at the top of TrustBadge:
  if (!trustLabel) return null;
This prevents crashes from null/undefined trust_label in manifest rows.
work_units.summary: Add light input guard for empty/null trustLabel in TrustBadge
